name: Sending email
description: Sends emails from the app through Resend, an email service, and says plainly when one isn't sent.
fits: Add it when the app has to send emails, such as telling its owner when someone signs up, or sending someone a confirmation.

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.reason: To send emails, your app uses Resend, an email service, and needs a key from it. Sign up for free at resend.com, then create a key on its API Keys page, resend.com/api-keys. Until you set up your own domain there, your app can only send emails to the address you signed up with.

edits: In worker-configuration.d.ts, add `RESEND_API_KEY?: string;` to the __BaseEnv_Env interface: it's a Secret, which isn't set until the Developer gives it.
Where the app sends an email, import `sendEmail` from `./email` (`./server/email` from src/index.ts) and call it as its notes say.
